partNotes.SpcNextChunkIndex: Start of the per-chunk loop inside SpcBlockTransfer: resets the sample-library pointer to bank C5 page 0, reads the next chunk index byte from the stream at Y in $32, and skips to SpcChunkDone when bit 7 marks an empty slot; otherwise accumulates the running SPC destination offset and enters SpcFindChunk.
partNotes.SpcFindChunk: Walks the C5 sample library: for each header word at [$4A], subtracts one from the wanted index in $2A until zero, skipping payload bytes and wrapping $4A at 32K page boundaries; when the target chunk is found, sets Y to the data offset and branches into SpcSendHeader with the handshake counter from $30.
partNotes.SpcSendChunkData: Byte loop for one library chunk after SpcSendHeader: reads from [$4A],Y with bank byte $4C, waits for APUIO0 echo, writes data and an incrementing counter to APUIO0/1, wraps Y at $8000, and exits when X (byte count) reaches zero.
partNotes.SpcSendHeader: Shared block header inside SpcBlockTransfer (also reached from SpcChunkDone when all chunks are done): pushes the continuation counter, writes chunk size to the port handshake, SPC RAM dest to APUIO2/3, more-data flag to APUIO1, disables NMI around the kick, waits for APUIO0 echo, optionally re-enables NMI when worldReadyFlag is $0F, then branches to SpcSendChunkData if more bytes remain or clears ports and returns.
partNotes.SpcSendRecord: IPL record sender inside SpcIplHandshake: pushes the kick counter, reads size and destination words from [$46],Y, disables NMI, writes port 1/2/3, kicks port 0 and waits for echo, restores NMI when worldReadyFlag is $0F, loops to the byte sender when overflow indicates data, else clears APUIO2 and returns with the saved P.

partNotes.SliderGlideTriggerNorthMain: Main per-frame entry of SliderGlideTriggerNorth after SetEntryHere: requires the player in a 32 px X window (trigger X minus 8 through plus $18), Y equal to trigger Y, Psycho Slide sprite bank, and animation $0F or $10, then redirects the player to SliderGlideNorth and calls LockPlayerForClimb; otherwise returns with RTL.
partNotes.SliderGlideTriggerNorthOffset: Entry variant in SliderGlideTriggerNorthEntry: COP NudgePosition shifts the trigger actor by (-8, 0) once, then BRA into SliderGlideTriggerNorthMain for the normal north-slide gate.

partNotes.FreezeCameraForAttack: Called from attack_ability_system before Psycho Dash and run attack paths: clears bit $0100 in the player actor flags and sets layerPriorityFlag bit $0200 so camera_scroll_controller stops scrolling, then falls through into RunAttackFlagSetup.
partNotes.UnfreezeCameraAfterAttack: Called when Psycho Dash animation completes: clears layerPriorityFlag $0200 so the camera scrolls again, then falls through into RunAttackCleanup.

partNotes.UseItem_IncaMantelMismatch: Shared mismatch tail for Inca statue placement on the wrong mantel shape: prints dialogstring_038772 and returns with RTS.
partNotes.UseItem_IncaStatueA_Mismatch: Reached from UseItem_IncaStatueA_CheckAlt when the player stands on mantel tiles ($15-$16, X $26): jumps to UseItem_IncaMantelMismatch instead of the spirits hint or generic query.
partNotes.UseItem_IncaStatueB_Mismatch: Alternate-position failure in UseItem_IncaStatueB_CheckAlt: prints the mantel shape mismatch string directly and returns without placing the statue.
partNotes.UseItem_FluteConfigureController: After a successful SpawnListAppend of FluteMusicActorController from UseItem_WindMelody (Y holds the new slot): ORs display-filter bit $1000 into the controller $12, sets track $19 in $26 and melody index 0 in $20, restores X, returns to the caller.
partNotes.FlutePlaybackPhase: Phase 2 entry of FluteMusicActorController after musicTransitionState is $FFFF: SetEntryHere polls APUIO1 each frame until $FF signals the melody finished, then clears player display-filter, restores walking idle pose, unmasks joypad, and SwitchCases on melody index into the effect handlers with return set to FluteRestoreMusicPhase.
partNotes.FluteRestoreMusicPhase: Phase 3 after the melody effect: spawns SpcTransferMusicData with chatPtr from saved DP $24, polls until musicTransitionState is $FFFF again, WaitByte one frame, then falls through into FluteControllerExit.
partNotes.FluteControllerExit: Cleanup for FluteMusicActorController: clears displayModeFlags bit $0080 (leave display-filter mode) and COP Die; reached on spawn failure and after restoration wait.

partNotes.DarkFriarTrailNorthInit: Spawn entry stub for the north Dark Friar trail: sets bit $2000 in actor $12 to negate Y movement so the shared south trail code runs upward, then falls into DarkFriarTrailSouth.

partNotes.FadeBackdropOutFast40: Thinker body: PaletteStart bundle $40 then PaletteStep runs the fast backdrop COLDATA fade (white to black), then KillThinker and RTL.

partNotes.FadePalette15In1F: Thinker body: PaletteStart bundle $1F then PaletteStep fades 16 grey colors into CGRAM palette 15 at $F0, then KillThinker and RTL.

partNotes.UseItemRefreshCursor: Use-tab loop head: positions the equip cursor from $1A, runs BG3 item list and detail scripts, yields, and branches on D-pad or confirm masks; entered from UseItemTab and after cursor moves.
partNotes.ArrangeSourceReset: Arrange tab setup after spawning the selection cursor: clears blink counter $1C, draws Arrange tab BG3 strings, then enters ArrangeSourceLoop.
partNotes.ArrangeSourceLoop: First-phase Arrange poll: positions the grid cursor at slot $22, yields, B cancels the tab, A picks a source slot via ArrangePickTarget, or D-pad navigation returns through a pushed resume address.
partNotes.ArrangeTargetLoop: Second-phase Arrange poll after a source slot is saved in $2E/$2C: positions the target cursor, B cancels target pick, confirm mask $8044 runs ArrangePerformSwap, else grid navigation loops.
partNotes.DiscardGridReset: Discard tab setup: clears $1C, draws Discard tab BG3 strings, then enters DiscardGridLoop.
partNotes.DiscardGridLoop: Discard tab poll: positions cursor, B leaves the tab, A runs DiscardAttempt, D-pad moves the grid with resume on the stack.
partNotes.SlotActorEvaluate: Per-frame entry for InventorySlotActor after ComputeSlotPosition: hides the slot actor when sprite frame $28 is zero, otherwise shows it and AnimOneFrame loops until refresh flag $2A is set.

partNotes.FadeBackdropIn1B: Thinker body: PaletteStart bundle $1B then PaletteStep runs the slow backdrop fixed-color ramp black toward near-white, then KillThinker and RTL.

partNotes.FadeBackdropOut1C: Thinker body: PaletteStart bundle $1C then PaletteStep runs the backdrop white-to-black fade counterpart to bundle $1B, then KillThinker and RTL.

partNotes.CircleWindowV1Entry: Credits circle-window thinker frame entry: SetEntryHere, HdmaCircleWindowBuildV1, then QueueHdma on config $26 using buffer A at tileStagingBuffer or B at $7E7100 based on chatPtr bit 0.
partNotes.CircleWindowV2Entry: Dream and vampire-lair thinker entry: HdmaInitPrevState once, then each frame HdmaCompareParams skips rebuild when unchanged, else HdmaCircleWindowBuildV2 and HdmaCopyCurrentToPrev, then QueueHdma with the same buffer select as V1.
partNotes.CircleNextRowV1: Bresenham row step inside HdmaCircleWindowBuildV1: advances Y offset $1C (by 2 on first entry), writes WH0/WH1 word pairs for symmetric rows, and loops until x drops below y or goes negative, else jumps back from the loop tail.
partNotes.CircleNextRowV2: Row step inside HdmaCircleWindowBuildV2: increments $1C, emits hold/repeat HDMA segments for above- and below-centre rows while y stays in range, then returns to the x/y loop or exits to HdmaCircleWindowExitV2.
partNotes.HdmaCircleWindowExitV1: Restore path for HdmaCircleWindowBuildV1: PLB, PLD, PLX and return; taken when parameters unchanged, radius negative, or the Bresenham loop finishes.
partNotes.HdmaCircleWindowExitV2: Restore path for HdmaCircleWindowBuildV2: same register restore and return; also reached when HdmaParamChangeCheck reports no parameter change or radius is negative.

partNotes.SlopeHandlerExit: Common tail after slope curve handlers in SlopeType0AHandler: calls ClampSpeeds, restores direct page and X from the entry save, returns with RTL.
partNotes.SlopeSpeedZeroLatch: Shared zero-speed branch from ApplySlopeCurvePosEW and NS helpers: clears slopeStepCounter, sets playerFlags bit $1000 (stopped on slope), returns with RTS to the caller.
partNotes.DecelResetCounterEW: Tail inside DecelerateEW when east-west speed reaches zero after a decel step: clears decelStepCounter and returns with RTS; also used from the west-moving decel paths.

partNotes.PushSolidRestorePlayerNorth: Idle restore for the north-side solid pull path: COP RestoreSavedPtr only.
partNotes.PushSolidRestorePlayerSouth: RestoreSavedPtr exit for the south-side solid pull.
partNotes.PushSolidRestorePlayerWest: RestoreSavedPtr exit for the west-side solid pull.
partNotes.PushSolidRestorePlayerEast: RestoreSavedPtr exit for the east-side solid pull.
partNotes.PushSolidDistPlayerNorth: Distance gate in the north-side solid pull path after abs Y delta: compares to $20 and branches to PushSolidRestorePlayerNorth when the player is too close; otherwise checks facing and collision.
partNotes.PushSolidDistPlayerWest: Distance gate in the west-side solid pull path after abs X delta: same $20 minimum before facing and tile tests.
partNotes.PushForceballMovePlayerNorth: Forceball pull when the player is above: distance and sprIdx $3A checks, facing down, NudgePosition (0,-$10), sound $2C, 16-step parent Y slide; south/west/east halves mirror with other facings and offsets.
partNotes.PushForceballRestorePlayerNorth: RestoreSavedPtr exit for the north-side forceball pull.
partNotes.PushForceballMovePlayerSouth: South half of forceball vertical pull: sprIdx $3B, facing up, nudge Y+$10, slide loop toward player.
partNotes.PushForceballRestorePlayerSouth: RestoreSavedPtr for south forceball pull failures or completion.
partNotes.PushForceballMovePlayerWest: West-side forceball pull with sprIdx $3D, facing right, X nudge -$10.
partNotes.PushForceballMovePlayerEast: East-side forceball pull with sprIdx $3C, facing left, X nudge +$10.
partNotes.PushForceballDistPlayerNorth: Minimum-distance check ($20) in PushForceballMovePlayerNorth before sprite and facing tests.
partNotes.PushForceballDistPlayerWest: Minimum-distance check ($20) in PushForceballMovePlayerWest before sprite and facing tests.
partNotes.CollectGemRestorePlayerNorth: RestoreSavedPtr when north-side gem alignment fails or the nudge step count in orbitAngle reaches zero.
partNotes.CollectGemRestorePlayerSouth: RestoreSavedPtr for the south-side gem nudge path.
partNotes.CollectGemRestorePlayerWest: RestoreSavedPtr for the west-side gem nudge path.
partNotes.CollectGemRestorePlayerEast: RestoreSavedPtr for the east-side gem nudge path.
partNotes.CollectGemNudgePlayerNorthHalf: After abs Y delta halved into orbitAngle: requires facing down, SetEntryHere, moves linked gem posY up 2 px per frame until the counter expires, then restores.
partNotes.CollectGemNudgePlayerWestHalf: West gem nudge: facing right, gem posX minus 2 per frame with the same orbitAngle countdown.

partNotes.RampSnapEastSouthBrWall: East ramp post-move corner fix when future TR is passable but BR is solid: calls SnapYSouthCollision then ApplyMovementDeltas; reached from EastRampDown/EastRampUp wall probes.
partNotes.RampSnapEastNorthTrWall: East ramp path when TR is blocked but BR is open: SnapYNorthCollision then ApplyMovementDeltas.
partNotes.RampSnapWestSouthBrWall: West ramp analogue of the TR-open BR-solid case: SnapYSouthCollision then ApplyMovementDeltas from WestRampDown/WestRampUp probes.
partNotes.RampSnapWestNorthTrWall: West ramp TR-blocked BR-open case: SnapYNorthCollision then ApplyMovementDeltas.
